# Laravel Boost MCP

## Configuration
- Port: 8080
- Commands: `search-docs`, `database-query`, `database-schema`, `browser-logs`
- Documentation search uses Context7 under the hood

## Usage Tips
- Use multiple broad queries when searching docs
- Do not add package names to search queries
